gaps.answer: to put up with any rudeness
gaps.lead: Delia said that she would no longer tolerate her colleagues being rude.
gaps.sentence: 'I am not willing ___ from my colleagues any longer,' said Delia.
gaps.explanation: 'Not willing to put up with rudeness' means will no longer tolerate it.

gaps.lead: It isn't necessary to book in advance.
gaps.explanation: 'Don't have to' = it is not necessary.

gaps.lead: I'd prefer it if you arrived before eight.
gaps.explanation: would rather + subject + past simple for other people's actions.

gaps.lead: You'll fail your exam if you don't revise.
gaps.explanation: unless + present simple = if you don't.

gaps.lead: People claim that this herbal tea cures colds.
gaps.explanation: X is claimed to + infinitive = people claim X does.

gaps.lead: A mechanic repaired my father's roof last week.
gaps.explanation: have something done = arrange for somebody to do it: had his roof repaired.
